'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**[[2025 Coeur d'Alene shooting]]
***A [[mass shooting]] [[ambush]] situation is reported when at least one person opens fire on firefighters and law enforcement responding to a [[wildfire]] on Canfield Mountain, believed to [[Arson|have been set]] by the perpetrator. Three people are killed, including the shooter, and seven others injured in [[Coeur d'Alene, Idaho|Coeur d'Alene]], [[Idaho]], United States. The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] is deployed and the shooter is later found dead.
